case_name: Suman Choudhary vs State Of Rajasthan & Ors

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Suman Choudhary, divorcee' woman seeking appointment as Teacher Grade-III, Level-I
parties.respondent_defendant: State of Rajasthan Through the Secretary, Rural and Panchayati Raj Department, Government of Rajasthan, Secretariat, Jaipur, Director, Elementary Education, Government of Rajasthan, Bikaner, Zila Parishad Jalore Through Its Chief Executive Officer, District Jalore

facts_of_case: Petitioner, a divorcee' woman, was rejected for appointment as Teacher Grade-III, Level-I due to lack of decree of divorce at the time of application. She had applied for judicial separation in July 2016 and received a decree of divorce on June 27, 2017.

legal_principles.principle: A candidate having attained widowhood even after the last date of submitting application form should be considered in widow category and should be given benefit of reservation under the said category.
legal_principles.held: The Division Bench has held that the candidate having attained widowhood even after the last date of submitting application form should be considered in widow category and should be given benefit of reservation under the said category.
cited_cases: State of Rajasthan & Ors. Vs. Ms. Jamna Rajpurohit, (2013) DB Civil Special appeal No.82/2013

legal_principles.principle: A clarification issued by the Director, Elementary Education cannot be applied retrospectively with respect to an advertisement.
legal_principles.held: Mr. Rathore had contended that the clarification which has been issued on 30.6.2017, cannot be applied retrospectively with respect to the advertisement, which had been issued on 6.7.2016;
use_in: cases involving retrospective application of rules

outcome.final_order: Petitioner's candidature for appointment as Teacher Grade-III, Level-I is hereby accepted.

use_for_drafting: drafting a writ petition for divorcee seeking appointment as teacher
advising on qualification requirements for teaching positions
assisting in drafting a judgment report
